description: Explicit simulator-level reset perturbation on real Isaac Lab captures. It is modeled after a reset-semantics failure observed while developing the parity harness and fixed in upstream commit 9aaa389. It is not a literal reproduction of that historical case: this adapter writes zero cart-pole joint velocity instead of the requested 0.5 rad/s, while the historical harness omitted a rigid-body root velocity write. The bundle records the deliberate switch. IVF validity and oracle decisions do not consume that bookkeeping field; they establish the trajectory and event consequences.
